system.prerequisites: Nature 2 ranks, Meditation or Mental Focus 2 ranks, Non-Shaman
system.description:
ADEPT

Something unseen has begun travelling beside you. Whether you sought it or it sought you is considerably less important than the fact that it has stayed.
Choose one Shaman Spirit Guide: Ancestor, Beast, Elemental, Land or Veil.
You gain that Spirit Guide's specialist skill and Spirit Boon.
You also gain Manifest Spirit as a Focus ability and gain the Manifestation associated with your chosen Spirit Guide.
Finally, you may learn feats possessing the Shaman (Adept) trait.

Prerequisites Nature 2 ranks, Meditation or Mental Focus 2 ranks, Non-Shaman

Progression Requirements Meditation or Mental Focus +10 ranks, chosen when this feat is selected

Works automatically: Use this feat to choose your Spirit Guide (Ancestor, Beast, Elemental, Land or Veil — its specialist skill and Spirit Boon arrive with it); Manifest Spirit arrives as a Focus ability and manifests that guide; Shaman class feats open to you.
